title: A Peaceful Day at Home
style: High-quality hand-drawn 2D Japanese anime film still with an original cozy slice-of-life aesthetic: painterly backgrounds, delicate line art, soft natural sunlight and warm golden colours, detailed everyday interiors, beautiful food and household details, cinematic composition. Not copying any existing film or artist. World (identical in every shot): a charming wooden countryside house with honey-coloured wooden walls and floors, white-curtained windows, potted green plants, a small bathroom with a wooden-framed mirror and a white sink, a cozy kitchen with a window over the sink and an open wooden dish shelf, a soft sage-green sofa beside a sunny window in the living room, and a small backyard garden with green grass, flowers, a wooden fence and a clothesline under a blue sky. Main character (the only person, identical whenever shown): a young woman with long dark brown hair tied in a loose low ponytail, a few loose strands framing her face, gentle brown eyes, slim natural proportions, wearing a simple plain yellow T-shirt and comfortable white shorts, barefoot indoors. Her pet (identical whenever shown): one fluffy orange tabby cat with darker orange stripes, a white chest and white paws, green eyes. No other people or animals. Vertical 9:16 composition. One single continuous full-bleed vertical illustration of ONE moment from ONE camera: the scene and the character appear only ONCE in the image (a mirror reflection is fine); not a comic, no panels, not two stacked pictures, no split screen, no borders. No text, no labels or lettering on products or book covers, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no artist signature, no handwriting anywhere.
motion_style: Hand-drawn 2D anime animation, calm slice-of-life, natural relaxed everyday movement, soft sunlight, gentle breeze, smooth slow camera movement, coherent face and hands, stable objects. Keep the painterly anime look and the same character and cat throughout. No text, no music, no speech, no singing.
negative: text, letters, labels, subtitles, captions, watermark, logo, signature, music, speech, singing, extra people, second woman, duplicated character, second cat, distorted face, extra fingers, changing outfit, exaggerated expressions, fast movement, flicker, two panels, stacked images, photorealistic, 3D render, CGI
music_prompt: Gentle relaxing instrumental for a peaceful anime daily-life video in a cozy countryside home: soft felt piano melody, gentle acoustic guitar, light music-box notes, warm ambient pads and subtle delicate flute, slow tempo around 60 bpm, peaceful, cozy, warm, nostalgic, one continuous gentle melody at a consistent low volume, soft fade at the end
music_negative: vocals, lyrics, singing, heavy drums, electronic dance, dramatic music, sudden volume changes, electric guitar, fast tempo, sound effects

shots.name: morning
shots.frame: The small wooden bathroom in warm morning sunlight from a little window: the young woman (yellow T-shirt, long dark brown hair in a loose ponytail) seen in three-quarter view standing at the white sink brushing her teeth, her calm sleepy face also reflected in the wooden-framed mirror, a little green plant on the windowsill, a ceramic cup with a toothbrush holder, a folded towel.
shots.motion: She brushes her teeth slowly and calmly, then rinses under the tap, morning light glows through the little window, the plant leaves stir slightly.
shots.sound: a toothbrush brushing, water running from the tap, birds singing outside

shots.name: laundry
shots.frame: The sunny backyard garden under a beautiful blue sky with soft clouds: the young woman (yellow T-shirt, white shorts, loose dark brown ponytail) pinning a freshly washed light blue shirt onto the clothesline with wooden pegs, colorful clean clothes and towels already hanging and swaying, a large metal washing basin with soapy water and a woven laundry basket on the grass beside her, green grass, flowers and a wooden fence.
shots.motion: She lifts the wet shirt from the basket and gently pins it to the line, the colorful clothes sway softly in the breeze, clouds drift.
shots.sound: gentle wind moving the clothesline, a little water splashing in the basin, birds singing

shots.name: lunch
shots.frame: The cozy wooden kitchen at midday: close medium shot of the young woman (yellow T-shirt, loose dark brown ponytail) at the stove stirring a sizzling pan of colorful vegetable stir-fry (carrots, green peppers, mushrooms, spring onions) with wooden chopsticks, steam rising, a wooden cutting board beside the stove with freshly sliced carrots and spring onions and a kitchen knife, a bowl of rice, sunlight through the kitchen window.
shots.motion: She stirs and tosses the vegetables in the pan, steam rises and swirls in the sunlight, she smiles softly at the aroma.
shots.sound: food sizzling in a pan, chopsticks stirring, a knife resting on the board

shots.name: dishes
shots.frame: At the kitchen sink beside the window with sunlit white curtains: the young woman (yellow T-shirt, loose dark brown ponytail) rinsing a white ceramic plate under gently flowing water from the tap, soap bubbles in the sink, clean dishes stacked neatly on the open wooden shelf beside the window.
shots.motion: Water flows gently over the plate as she rinses it, then she places the clean plate neatly on the wooden shelf, the curtains stir softly in the sunlight.
shots.sound: dishes being washed, water flowing from the tap, a plate set on a wooden shelf

shots.name: cat
shots.frame: The living room in warm afternoon light: the young woman (same yellow T-shirt and white shorts, loose dark brown ponytail) sitting comfortably on the soft sage-green sofa beside the sunny window with a book resting on her lap, and the fluffy orange tabby cat (darker orange stripes, white chest and white paws) hopping up onto the sofa cushion beside her, a cushion and a knitted blanket on the sofa, plants by the window.
shots.motion: The orange cat jumps softly onto the sofa, turns around and curls up beside her, she smiles and reaches to stroke its head.
shots.sound: soft footsteps of the cat, a gentle thump on the cushion, quiet cat purring

shots.name: afternoon
shots.frame: Closer shot on the sofa: the young woman (yellow T-shirt, loose dark brown ponytail) peacefully reading an open book (pages with no legible writing) held in one hand while her other hand gently pets the sleeping curled-up orange tabby cat (white chest and paws) beside her, a warm ray of golden afternoon sunlight falling across the sofa and the cat.
shots.motion: She turns a page slowly while gently stroking the sleeping cat, the cat breathes softly and its ear twitches, the camera slowly moves closer.
shots.sound: a page turning, gentle cat purring, birds faintly outside
